gcide.name: GCIDE (Webster 1913 public domain portion)
gcide.note: Only entries sourced from '1913 Webster' are used

chambers1908.name: Chambers's Twentieth Century Dictionary (1908)
chambers1908.note: Definitions redistributed; etymology used build-time only.

moby_common.name: Moby Words II COMMON
moby_common.note: Build-time quality signal (cross-dictionary word coverage). Not redistributed.

allens_synonyms.name: Allen's Synonyms and Antonyms (F. Sturges Allen, 1920)
allens_synonyms.note: Synonym word-lists merged into s[] plus a cross-source coverage signal.

cmudict.name: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary
cmudict.note: Build-time cross-source coverage signal (headword existence). No text redistributed.

wiktionary.name: Wiktionary via kaikki.org
wiktionary.note: Build-time cross-validation for quality scores only. Not redistributed.

conceptnet.name: ConceptNet 5.7
conceptnet.note: Build-time quality signals only, NOT redistributed in words.json

llm_augmented.name: LLM-augmented definitions (Claude/Anthropic)
llm_augmented.note: Curated definitions for words absent from PD sources and improved senses for terse existing entries.

opengloss.name: OpenGloss v1.3 Dictionary
opengloss.note: Synthetic LLM-generated glosses. Coverage gap-fill for headwords absent from PD sources (primary sense, frequency-prioritized). Attribution required.

mongodb_defs.name: MongoDB English Words Definitions
mongodb_defs.note: Definitions generated by Claude 3.7 Sonnet. Coverage gap-fill for headwords absent from PD sources. Attribution required.
